techStack: React 19, TypeScript ~5.7.2, Vite 6, Vitest 3 — ESM throughout
noUnusedLocals: true and noUnusedParameters: true — unused imports/vars are compile ERRORS, not warnings
verbatimModuleSyntax: true — type-only imports must use 'import type' syntax
tsc -b runs before vite build; TypeScript must be clean for the build to succeed
Tests run via 'pnpm test' (vitest run); TS checked via 'pnpm --filter benchmark-frontend exec tsc --noEmit'
Coverage is scoped specifically to src/utils/productFilters.ts — changes there are under measurement
No path aliases; all imports use relative paths
features: filterProducts(products, filters) applies: search (trim+lowercase), category (strict equality, skipped when 'All'), inStock (skipped when false), then sort
visibleProducts useMemo in App.tsx is a full inline reimplementation of filterProducts — duplicated logic that produces identical results
filterProducts is imported in App.tsx but NEVER called — this is an unused import (TS error under noUnusedLocals)
normalizeSearch does val.trim().toLowerCase() — exported from productFilters.ts, referenced nowhere else, admitted dead code
filterProducts has 4 return statements: 3 early returns after each sort branch (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc), 1 final 'return result' for sortBy='default'
Features that must not regress: search (case-insensitive, trimmed), category filter, in-stock filter, all sort modes, clear filters, initial render count, pagination
architecture: Layer structure: types/ → utils/ (pure functions) → api/ → hooks/ (async state) → components/ (dumb UI) → App.tsx (orchestrator)
Data flow: useProductFilters returns raw products+filters state → App derives visibleProducts → passes to ProductList/FilterPanel/SortSelect
filterProducts belongs in utils/ (pure, no React); it should be called in App.tsx where products and filters are co-located
Test files live in tests/ at project root (one level above src/); they render the full App component and must not be modified
Only 2 source files need to change: src/App.tsx and src/utils/productFilters.ts
Files that must stay unchanged: all tests/, hooks/useProductFilters.ts, components/*, types/product.ts
edgeCases: sortBy='default': both implementations skip sorting and return filtered array in original order — refactor preserves this
sortBy='name' is not in the FilterState type union and not handled — falls through to unsorted result (same as 'default'); no test covers it
Search trimming: both implementations call .trim() before matching — behavior identical after refactor
Whitespace-only search input (e.g. '   '): trimmed to '', filter is skipped, all products pass — no test covers this explicitly
Empty product list: filterProducts([]) returns [] safely; categories useMemo in App.tsx yields ['All'] — no crash
normalizeSearch has zero import sites in src/ and zero in tests/ — deletion causes no TS errors and no test failures
Removing the inline sort branches and using a single consolidated return must still handle sortBy='default' returning unsorted filtered list

tasks.requirement: 4. filterProducts in productFilters.ts does not contain multiple early-return statements for individual sort branches; the sort-and-return pattern is consolidated into a single return.

The 'default' case (no sort) must still return the unsorted filtered array.
